title: annealer profile
description: Attribute ordering profile for annealer. Groups are listed in output priority order; each attribute goes to the group whose `match` pattern fits its normalized name most specifically (exact name beats the longest `prefix*`). Unmatched attributes go to the fallback group.

extends.description: Profiles this profile builds on: a built-in profile name (`html`, `vue`) or a path relative to this file (CLI only), or a list of them. Later entries override earlier ones and this profile overrides them all: mappings merge key by key, lists and other values are replaced, and groups merge by name.

normalize.description: Attribute name rewrites applied before classification.

hyphenateComponentProps.description: Rewrite camelCase attribute names on component tags (PascalCase or hyphenated names, excluding native SVG/MathML elements) to kebab-case.

closingBracketNewline.description: Put the closing bracket of a multiline start tag on its own line (like `vue/html-closing-bracket-newline`).

oneAttributePerLine.description: In a start tag whose attributes span several lines, put each attribute on its own line (like `vue/max-attributes-per-line` for multiline tags).

normal.description: Empty non-void elements: `always` → `<div />`. Applied in Vue templates only, because `<div />` is an unclosed start tag in plain HTML.

component.description: Empty components: `always` → `<MyComp />`. Applied in Vue templates only.

contentNewline.description: Put the content of a multiline element (its end tag starts on a later line than its start tag) on lines of its own (like `vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline`). Elements without content are left alone. Omit this key to turn the rule off; `{}` turns it on with the defaults.

ignore.description: Elements left alone, together with everything inside them. Element names match case-insensitively; component names match exactly. Defaults to `pre`, `textarea`, and inline elements, where added whitespace could be visible.

allowEmptyLines.description: Keep empty lines before and after the content instead of collapsing them to a single line break.

groups.description: Attribute groups in output priority order. Exactly one group must be the fallback (after merging, with `extends`).

stylesheet.description: Declaration ordering for `<style>` blocks and standalone stylesheets. Only the order changes: declarations are moved as written, and whitespace, quotes and other formatting are left to a formatter. Omit this key to leave stylesheets untouched.

declarationOrder.description: Property order. `smacss`: most important, flow-affecting properties first. `concentric`: from outside the box model inward. `alphabetical`: a-z.

declarationOrderGroupBy.description: How declarations are split into independently sorted runs. Other statements and comments always end a run. `non-declaration-and-empty-line` (default): a blank line also ends a run. `non-declaration`: declarations are sorted across blank lines, which stay where they are.

vendorPrefix.description: Where vendor-prefixed declarations (`-webkit-…`, `-moz-…`) go when `declarationOrder` is set. `alongside`: next to the unprefixed property (malva's behavior). `start`: before the other declarations of the same run, in simple alphabetical order, so the standard property is declared last and wins where the prefixed one is an alias.

styleAttribute.description: Also order the declarations of static `style` attributes (bound `:style` is never touched). Declarations are moved as written. Values that don't parse as plain declarations (template syntax, character references) are left as written.

classOrder.description: Order of the classes in static `class` attributes (bound `:class` is never touched): a built-in class order name (`tailwind`, `bootstrap`) or a class order profile. Omit this key to keep classes in their order.

groupPatch.description: A group in a profile with `extends`. A group named like an inherited group updates it key by key (`match` is replaced, not appended to); a new group is appended unless `before`/`after` places it.

match.description: Patterns matched against normalized, lowercased attribute keys: an exact name, or a prefix ending in `*`. Keys are `foo` for `foo`/`:foo`/`v-bind:foo`, `v-on:click` for `@click`, `v-slot:name` for `#name`; modifiers are stripped.

sort.description: Order within the group. `source`: as written. `alphabetical`: by key. `listed`: by the order of the `match` patterns.

fallback.description: Receives every attribute no pattern matches.

spreadSafe.description: Attributes in this group may be moved across a `v-bind="object"` spread (only for compile-time directives that never merge with the spread object).

before.description: Place the group right before the named group (inherited or listed earlier). Moves an inherited group when it updates one.

after.description: Place the group right after the named group (inherited or listed earlier). Moves an inherited group when it updates one.
